title: alangium salviifolium subsp. sundanum
intro: Alangium salviifolium subsp. sundanum, commonly known as Sundan Alangium, is a plant species within the Alangiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which can aid in wound healing and reduce the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of Sundan Alangium are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are believed to have antioxidant, anti-histaminic, and anti-inflammatory effects. Further research is required to fully understand the efficacy and potential applications of Sundan Alangium in traditional medicine.
